function: A multi-line text input control (text area).

attributes.name: autofocus
attributes.function: Specifies that a text area should automatically get focus when the page loads

attributes.name: cols
attributes.function: Specifies the visible width of a text area

attributes.name: dirname
attributes.function: Specifies that the text direction of the textarea will be submitted

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.function: Specifies that a text area should be disabled

attributes.name: form
attributes.function: Specifies which form the text area belongs to

attributes.name: maxlength
attributes.function: Specifies the maximum number of characters allowed in the text area

attributes.name: name
attributes.function: Specifies a name for a text area

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.function: Specifies a short hint that describes the expected value of a text area

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.function: Specifies that a text area should be read-only

attributes.name: required
attributes.function: Specifies that a text area is required/must be filled out

attributes.name: rows
attributes.function: Specifies the visible number of lines in a text area

attributes.name: wrap
attributes.function: Specifies how the text in a text area is to be wrapped when submitted in a form
